ParameterDescription.Name: Front Controller Parameter - Fast under voltage threshold

ParameterDescription.Name: Front Controller Parameter - Analog brake fault range
ParameterDescription.Description: Analog brake voltage fault range. Distance below minimum and above maximum that the analog input value, in Volts, that the sensor input must be before triggering an analog brake fault. eg. For an analog brake sensor voltage range of 1-4V, a fault range of 0.2V means the controller will fault when a voltage below 0.8V or above 4.2V is measured on the brake input for a period of 100ms. This fault will automatically clear if the voltage is within the valid range for 100ms.

ParameterDescription.Name: Rear Controller Parameter - Analog Brake Deadband Range
ParameterDescription.Description: Analog brake voltage deadband. Distance above minimum and below maximum that the analog input value, in Volts, that the sensor input must be before changing from the minimum/maximum braking response. eg. For an analog brake sensor voltage range of 1-4V, a deadband of 0.2V means braking will start at 1.2V, and reach the maximum braking value at 3.8V.

ParameterDescription.Name: Rear Controller Parameter - Analog brake fault range
ParameterDescription.Description: Analog brake voltage fault range. Distance below minimum and above maximum that the analog input value, in Volts, that the sensor input must be before triggering an analog brake fault. eg. For an analog brake sensor voltage range of 1-4V, a fault range of 0.2V means the controller will fault when a voltage below 0.8V or above 4.2V is measured on the brake input for a period of 100ms. This fault will automatically clear if the voltage is within the valid range for 100ms.
